name: Electromagnetic Industries
old_description: Our switchgear and motor control products help you power through any situation by supplying quality motor control performance and top-notch switchgear protection. Keeping you in control of your business at all times.
about:
Electromagnetic Industries operates from Bartlett, Illinois, where it has served customers for decades as a family-owned manufacturer of instrument transformers and electronic modules. The company emphasizes its U.S.-based production and a culture built around family, employees, and clients.

The product line centers on low-voltage current transformers for metering, protection, and relay applications; potential transformers for accurate voltage measurement and isolation; and electronic modules for arc-fault detection and motor control. These components are designed for switchgear, motor control centers, data centers, solar farms, and broader industrial power systems. Manufacturing is described as electronic manufacturing solutions, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span the switchgear, motor control, data center, solar energy, and general industrial sectors. The company positions its transformers and electronics as critical for scaling high voltage and current to standardized levels for measuring instruments and protective relays, with applications in low-voltage power distribution and renewable energy installations.

Electromagnetic Industries highlights its "Made in USA" sourcing, warranty-backed products, and a legacy of integrity rooted in family ownership. The firm states that its electronic manufacturing solutions aim to optimize performance and protect power systems, though specific differentiators such as lead times or tolerance capabilities are not published.
